hook.name: QuoteAssetCreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token/quote-asset pools that charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap, denominated in the quote asset. Fees are split 0.9% to the token creator's reward vault and 0.1% to a launcher fee recipient, implemented via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta returns. Pools must be registered by the token creator before swaps are permitted.
